Rationale for Proposed Changes per The 23Theatre BA is currently suspended and only open to those students who are pursuing a degree in Elementary.
Education.We propose reinstating the BA for all eligible students in order to serve the shifting demographic of our student body as well as refine our BFA program to introduce more rigorous standards appropriate to a pre-24professional training. program.
The Rhode Island Promise Act has increased the number of transfer students considerably, making it highly difficult for those students to complete a BFA in 4 years.Additionally, the number of double majors/minors has increased making it equally difficult for those students to complete the very narrow BFA curriculum without impact to their other majors (particularly those, such as Nursing, who also have to meet clinical requirements that tend to conflict with our required courses).
A BA offers more flexibility for order of courses, thus making it more feasible for our transfer students and those completing more than one major.

URI Theatre completed an External Review in Spring of 2024.Among their recommendations was to standardize evaluation tools across our curriculum and instate more rigorous standards for degree completion,including capstone performances and projects.
Many BFA programs also involve standards that, if not met, result in dismissal from the program, lt has never been the policy of UR! theatre to dismiss students from our program except in very rare cases of academic failure.
Introducing this type of standardization is.possible if we have the option to invite students to our BA program in the event that the BFA curriculum is not a good fit.
Bifurcating our program in this way allows URl Theatre to serve the widest number of students while also introducing more clear standards for our BFA students.
The reinstatement of the BA does not require any new courses or staffing.
Students in the BAprogram will be taking courses already offered in our existing curriculum but have more choice in terms of when and what they take.
Because our program has undergone some changes to course codes since the suspension of the BA, we include here the courses we propose for completion of the BA in Theatre.

Optional electives within the major include THE112, THE200, THE300, THE400.
For many students, this would include participating in our.production season for which they receive course credit(THE200/300/400).
Students must complete a minimum of 30 credits at the 300-20level or above (these may include 300-level courses offered inside the major or courses offered outside the program).
